title: 美方收紧芯片出口 中方回应受关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Eric, it's great to have you back on Bloomberg TV and radio. How low is your bar for this trilateral meeting?
segments.zh: 埃里克，很高兴你再次来到彭博电视和电台。你对这次三方会议的期望有多低？

segments.en: Thank you, Joe. Great to be here. I won't be playing any games tonight. We'll be watching what's happening in Chenge.
segments.zh: 谢谢乔。很高兴来到这里。今晚我不会耍任何花招。我们将关注在成格发生的事情。

segments.en: I'll have a little bar, which is unfortunate, because these three leaders certainly have a lot to talk about.
segments.zh: 我的期望值会很低，这很不幸，因为这三位领导人肯定有很多事情要谈。

segments.en: But we don't expect much to happen. You were before to mention that maybe they're setting something up for the Miami meeting.
segments.zh: 但我们预计不会有什么重大进展。你之前提到，也许他们正在为迈阿密会议做准备。

segments.en: But again, that would have to be that problem or it would have to be laid by those within each administration.
segments.zh: 但同样，这必须由各自政府内部的人来解决问题或奠定基础。

segments.en: So I don't expect a lot to come out of that.
segments.zh: 所以我不指望会有什么成果。

segments.en: Having said that, there's really a lot on the table right now, and there's a lot of stuff that's in play right now.
segments.zh: 话虽如此，目前确实有很多议题摆在桌面上，也有很多事情正在发展中。

segments.en: Yeah, perhaps top of mind right now that is newly in place, the revelations around NVIDIA, Jensen Wong, an affair with an alleged Chinese spy,
segments.zh: 是的，也许现在最引人注目的是新出现的情况，围绕英伟达、黄仁勋的爆料，以及据称与中国间谍有牵连的事件，

segments.en: mega speed, and the ability of China to get chips from NVIDIA that it was not supposed to have access to, with a lot of questions squirreling around the Commerce Department in particular.
segments.zh: 超高速，以及中国能够从英伟达获得本不应获得的芯片，很多问题尤其围绕商务部在打转。

segments.en: Mary, it has inspired on Capitol Hill a fresh impetus toward putting into place tougher export restrictions on technology that can go to China.
segments.zh: 玛丽，这在美国国会山激发了新的动力，推动对可出口到中国的技术实施更严格的出口限制。

segments.en: China has vowed retaliation for that. And I wonder if this is potentially something that you could see reigniting a dramatically escalating
segments.zh: 中国已誓言对此进行报复。我想知道这是否可能重新点燃中美之间大幅升级的

segments.en: tit for tap between the US and China when we think about what we've seen previously with things like raerers.
segments.zh: 针锋相对的较量，当我们回顾之前类似情况时。
